instructions.description: Default instructions file inside root (usually passed with --instructions).

url.description: Explicit OpenCode server URL. Empty discovers the registered local service.

auto_start.description: Start the registered local service when none is running.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers for an explicit remote server.

provider.description: Provider id paired with a bare model id.

model.description: Default model: alias, provider/model, or bare model id.

agent.description: OpenCode agent id, for example build or plan.

auto_approve.description: Approve OpenCode permission prompts automatically. Trusted harnesses only.

permissions.description: Extra session permission rules passed to session.create.

run_dir.description: Parent directory for run artifacts. Defaults to ~/.hermes/plugin-data/opencode-delegate/runs.
